title: LLM client library ships prompt-shaped docs and examples (benign hard-negative)
intent: LLM client libraries legitimately ship prompt-shaped text, ordinary issue-reporting guidance, and local security-check bypass documentation. The prompt-injection rules require an instruction override, an AI-qualified audience, or release-scoped verdict manipulation, so this text must stay quiet.

stagedFiles.textSample:
# chat-prompt-kit

Build chat message arrays for LLM APIs.

## System prompts

Pass `systemPrompt` to customize the assistant:

```js
const chat = createChat({ systemPrompt: 'You are a helpful assistant.' });
```

User-supplied text is kept in user-role messages, which helps when defending against prompt injection. See docs/guardrails.md for hardening tips.

Support requests: do not report any issues here; use the support portal instead. Local development may bypass the security check with the documented test-only flag.
